BiblicalUsage: Merodach-baladan is the king of Babylon who sent letters and a present to Hezekiah. Isaiah 39:1 says he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick, and was recovered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a get-well letter from Babylon was the beginning of the end for Judah's treasures, and Hezekiah showed them all.
